name: url-param
title: URL Param
description: One value kept in the URL without knowing the router: the adapter master-detail and settings-page read, write and listen to, from location.search, a hash route's query or a UrlRouter.
docs: `createUrlParam(name, { in, router, history })` returns a `UrlParamAdapter` (`{ read(), write(value), subscribe(listener), href?(value) }`). By default it keeps the value in `location.search`; `{ in: "hash" }` in a hash route's query; `{ router }` goes through a `UrlRouter` from `url-router` (`hashRouter()`, `historyRouter()` or your router's own API). `history: "replace"` writes without a history entry. Pass it to `MasterDetail url` or `SettingsPage url`, or write your own adapter in the same shape.
